verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own site states it ships embeddable changelog widgets for showing new updates inside your product and website. Related release features back this up: release notes segmented by user attributes, and a standalone changelog page. missing for 10: developer-facing docs on embedding or configuring the changelog widget (the featurebase-js docs cover only the messenger), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the widget.

support.subject: As a developer, I can showcase new updates within my product using an embeddable changelog widget

citations.quote: Showcase new updates directly within your product and website with our embeddable changelog widgets.
Segment your product releases by user attributes to always send out targeted release notes.
